overall: MARGINAL, poor in the south and at Ciron this morning
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind (E–ENE, sustained per ECMWF). Ciron, Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot are at 16–17 kt right now and only ease to 13–14 kt by late morning. A rain burst hits the south and central grounds ~9 AM–noon (Cabunlawan and Decabaitot ~3.6 mm/h). Everything calms down ~3–6 PM, then wind builds again on the south grounds and Ciron from ~8 PM. Currents are mostly mild (0.2–0.6 kt now).

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Today got worse: 4 grounds are now POOR on wind (there were none yesterday afternoon): Ciron 17.2 kt (gusts 23.7), Nangalao 16.9 (g23.3), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 16.2 (g22.5). Only Decabobo is GOOD (6 were GOOD yesterday afternoon). Thu 15 is now the worst day of the week: gusts are up to 21 kt (were 18) and rain to ~8.0 mm (was ~6.3). Wind stays at 13 kt.

The next few days improved. Fri 16 eased (12 kt, gusts 17, ~8.7 mm; was 14 kt, gusts 20, ~10.8 mm), and it is no longer the worst day. Tue 20 moved up from MARGINAL to GOOD (5.8 kt, ~6.4 mm; was ~12.6 mm), and Mon 19 is now the best day (4.1 kt). That means three GOOD fishing days in a row (Sun–Tue) instead of two.

Supply: it still softens through Saturday, and the tightest point moves earlier to Friday , when today's catch lands. The refill still starts Sunday evening (ABOVE NORMAL) and now lasts into Wednesday. Currents are a little easier: the evening peak is 0.8–0.9 kt at Tara and Turda (was 1.0–1.2).

bestWindow.headline: Today ~1–5 PM (Decabobo, Tara, Turda) · Fri ~midnight–5 AM (Decabobo, Tara, Turda, Coron, Galoc)
details: ~1–5 PM on Decabobo, Tara and Turda: wind 4.0–9.7 kt, currents 0.0–0.5 kt, only light rain (≤0.4 mm/h). Coron and Galoc join from ~3 PM (wind 7.8–10.2 kt, current 0.3–0.4). Get back before the ~6–9 PM showers.

Fri ~midnight–5 AM: Decabobo is nearly slack (0.0–0.2 kt) with 1.9–4.4 kt wind. Tara and Turda currents fall to 0.1–0.5 kt with the same light wind and dry from ~3 AM. Coron and Galoc are at 5.7–7.3 kt (Coron current 0.2–0.3 kt). The model's single best hour in the next 24h is ~midnight at Decabobo (2.0 kt, current 0.0 kt). The model rates the next 24h POOR overall because of the south and Ciron; Decabobo is the best spot and does look calm then.

Keep boats off Ciron this morning (15.7–17.2 kt until ~9 AM) and from ~9 PM to Fri dawn (14.5–16.5 kt). Avoid Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot this morning (16–17 kt at 6 AM, 13–14 kt until ~1 PM, ~3.6 mm/h rain 9 AM–noon) and late tonight (14–15.5 kt). Alava's current picks up to 0.8–1.0 kt Fri ~2–5 AM.
